messages:
Mia: sharing a quick mock — trying a compact request card for the trace viewer. main asks: should stacktrace be inline collapsed by default, or a separate flyout? also thinking about where the correlation-id copy button should live. figma: https://figma.com/.../compact-request-card

Alex: i like inline collapse for quick scans, but large traces will blow out the card height. if collapsed by default we should surface a clear affordance to expand. maybe show top 1-2 frames and a "Show full stack" CTA.

Jamie: product +1 on collapsed by default for density. question on metrics: do we have telemetry for how often users expand entire stack vs copy corr-id? that should drive placement of the copy button.

Oliver: accessibility notes — if inline collapsible region is used, make sure it's keyboard-focusable and announced properly. suggestion: use a button with aria-expanded and a region with role="region" and aria-label="Stack trace for request <id>" so screenreaders know the context. also ensure the copy corr-id button has aria-describedby pointing to a helper text like "Copies correlation id to clipboard".

Mia: good call. design thought: copy button currently sits right-aligned inside card header. alternative: put it near the correlation id pill so it's clear what it copies. worried about clutter though.

Alex: engineering constraints: moving the button next to the pill is fine, but keep click targets 44px min. also if we put copy + tooltip + new icon we should avoid layout shift on hover. tooltips should be visually hidden for SR and provided via aria-label.

Mia: copy text proposals:
- button label (visually hidden for SR): "Copy correlation id"
- tooltip: "Copied!" state update should use aria-live="polite"

Oliver: +1. ensure the "Copied!" uses aria-live only for the success state (so we don't spam). also keyboard users need a visible focus ring and the expand button should be reachable via tab order before the stack contents.

Jamie: quick UX trade: show top frame + relative timestamp in collapsed view, expand shows full stack and file links. when exporting, users expect a single trace JSON export and a separate "download stack as txt" — we should surface both under a compact dropdown to save space.

Alex: implementational note: large trace export should stream; we can add an endpoint `GET /traces/:id/export?format=txt` and a small client-side spinner for >5s.

Mia: updated mock uploaded, addressed focus order and moved copy pill. please review — main open items: exact copy for buttons, placement of export dropdown (header vs actions menu), and final a11y labels. tagging for quick sign-offs: @Oliver for a11y, @Alex for engineering feasibility, @Jamie for product. :eyes:

design-bot: Figma file updated (version 3). Percy snapshot queued for visual diff.

Alex: will review tomorrow AM, leaning 👍 to collapsed default + inline top frames + export dropdown in header.

Oliver: will do a quick a11y pass and suggest exact aria strings by EOD.

Jamie: fine with current direction. Mia, can you sync copy in the mock to say "Show full stack" and "Download trace (JSON) / Download stack (TXT)"? then we can handoff to eng.

Mia: done — updated labels in figma and added notes for aria and telemetry. thanks all! :tada:
